historical_event.name: RMS Titanic Maiden Voyage
historical_event.description: The RMS Titanic sets sail from Southampton on her maiden (and final) voyage, carrying over 2,200 passengers and crew. She would sink five days later after striking an iceberg.

techmeme.headline: EFF Leaves X Platform
techmeme.context: After nearly 20 years, the Electronic Frontier Foundation announced it's logging off X, stating X is no longer where the fight is happening.

science_daily.headline: Dragonflies can see a color humans can't and it could change medicine
science_daily.summary: Dragonflies may see the world in a way that pushes beyond human limits—and surprisingly, they do it using the same molecular trick we evolved ourselves. Scientists discovered that these insects can detect extremely deep red light, even edging into near-infrared, thanks to a specialized visual protein strikingly similar to the one in human eyes. This ability likely helps them spot mates mid-flight by picking up subtle differences in reflected light.
